richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the handbrake cable yellow plastic ferrule could fail resulting in excess handbrake travel and allowing the vehicle to move unexpectedly.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the handbrake cable with an improved version.
richiami.titolo: On affected vehicles the handbrake cable yellow plastic ferrule could fail resulting in excess handbrake travel and allowing the vehicle to move unexpectedly.
